subject.title: [Feature] Compaction progress visibility for webchat + watchdog diagnostics API

question: Should OpenClaw add compaction-specific staged WebChat/Gateway diagnostics, and which compaction facts are safe to expose directly to users or operators?
rationale: The missing behavior is real, but the requested fix adds Gateway event/API surface, diagnostic retention/redaction policy, and overlaps an already-decided plugin path for Session Memory.

options.title: Narrow core observability contract
options.body: Extend the existing compaction event and diagnostics surfaces with bounded stage and timing metadata, and document Session Memory as a context-engine plugin path.

options.title: Docs and existing notices only
options.body: Keep current start/end indicators, notifyUser, compaction-notifier, and diagnostics.stability, then improve docs so users can discover the existing knobs and plugin path.

options.title: Dedicated compaction diagnostics API
options.body: Add a new compaction-specific endpoint or CLI with explicit operator scope, retention limits, and redaction rules for lock/model/session details.

recommendation.title: Narrow core observability contract
recommendation.body: Extend the existing compaction event and diagnostics surfaces with bounded stage and timing metadata, and document Session Memory as a context-engine plugin path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current routing signal from WebChat compaction progress and adjacent context-engine compaction delegate work.
